metadata.title: For The Love Of Pumpkin | Pumpkin Pitika & Pumpkin with Fermented Fish Recipe
metadata.description:
In this video, I am going to share with you a bit of rant about the plight of tribals who live in the remote areas. 
Also, I am sharing two pumpkin recipes. One an Assamese Pitika recipe made of pumpkins and the other a Garo recipe of Pumpkins and  fermented fish.

www.bensound.com

Artist: http://incompetech.com/

Thank you for watching.
